title: Base Read/Write Multiple Registers variant 4
purpose: Vary read and write address ranges together while preserving the relationship between write quantity, byte count, and register payload.
expected_behavior: The server should process the setup write if supported, then parse the combined read/write request and return the selected read-register values or a protocol-defined exception.
constraints_preserved: Setup MBAP length 0006 matches a five-byte FC06 PDU
Target MBAP length 000f matches a fourteen-byte FC17 PDU
Read quantity 0002 and write quantity 0002 are explicit
Write byte count 04 equals two 16-bit register values
Write payload contains exactly two register values
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report was supplied or used; field choices and expected behavior reflect model-prior plausibility and the supplied Base constraints only.
